original: Hello, how can I help you today?
Hi, I was wondering what happens if I'm late paying my subscription fee?
Glad to help. May I have your name please?
thanks Alessandro. Give me a second.
Account has been pulled up for Alessandro Phoenix.
You need to get an extension for paying the bill.
Can you please let me know your Account ID and Order ID to verify your identity?
I don't have an Account ID or an Order ID.
what is your membership level then?
I was thinking of buying some things and I just wondered what happens if I'm late on a payment.
I might have misread because you said you are late paying the subscription fee.
I guess I probably am late.
But I wanted to buy some things and didn't know what would happen.
Sorry to be such a bother.
Do you mean you will be late for paying the next bill?
Membership level of gold has been noted.
I'm really sorry but I probably am already late.
I will give an extension since you are a gold member.
So I can go ahead and order things?
You've been a big help. Thanks
You are welcome. Is there anything else that I can help you with?
Account has been updated with extend subscription.
